description: CREATE a Mixamo T-pose auto-rigged character or enemy and save it to Library. GPU generation by default. To sculpt from a picture (image-to-3D): pass concept_item (lib_… from gripforge_concept_correct / character_concepts), or path / file_url of a T-pose or concept PNG. Without an image, this is text-to-3D only. If the look may already be in the locker, call gripforge_style_kit FIRST. For knives/guns use gripforge_generate_weapon. Costs 10 credits. Returns job_id immediately; poll gripforge_generation_read. Closing this call does not cancel it.

concept_item.description: Library concept / T-pose sheet id (lib_…). Image-to-3D from that picture — not text-to-3D.

engine.description: GPU engine, only with provider gpu: hunyuan (Hunyuan3D 2.1, shape then paint) or trellis2 (TRELLIS.2). Server default GRIPFORGE_GPU_ENGINE, else hunyuan.

file_url.description: https URL of a concept or T-pose image. Image-to-3D.

idempotency_key.description: Stable asset request key; reuse after an uncertain response.

out_dir.description: After the job completes, gripforge_library_pull into this folder.

path.description: Absolute path to a local concept or T-pose image (PNG/JPG/WebP). Image-to-3D.

prompt.description: Description. "stylish gothic action enemy" → tagged with that look, kind=enemy. Up to 2000 characters: the on-demand GPU (provider gpu) always takes them; another provider refuses a text over its own limit with the error prompt_too_long_for_provider.

provider.description: Default gpu, with or without an image. An explicit provider overrides this choice; tripo with concept_item / path / file_url uses meshy. gpu = our rented GPU: Hunyuan3D 2.1 (default engine) or TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D, then the game-ready chain (shape gate, normalisation, decimation, normal + AO bake from the high-poly, meta.gameReady verdict); text-only first makes a concept image; no Tripo/Meshy generation spend.

rig.description: provider gpu only: true = rig with Tripo (only when Tripo is configured on the server); omitted = automatic rig on the GPU box (GripForge biped skeleton, meta.rig = tokenrig; the character stays unrigged with a note if it fails); false = no rig (meta.rig = none).

underwear.description: false = keep the described outfit. Implied false when an image is passed.

name: gripforge_generate_character
